takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $14.5B, up 279% from a year ago and 41% from the prior quarter — about $80 of every $100 Nvidia took in — as cloud builders raced to train and run generative AI on Hopper chips.
takeaways.title: Data Center became the company

takeaways.text: A 74.0% gross margin — up from 53.6% a year ago — turned the sales surge into $9.2B of net income, up 1,259% from a year ago and 49% from the prior quarter.
takeaways.title: Margins reached record levels

takeaways.text: Nvidia guided next-quarter revenue to $20.0B, plus or minus 2%, with a GAAP gross margin of 74.5% — a further step up from this quarter's record $18.1B.
takeaways.title: Guidance pointed higher still

verdict: Nvidia's revenue tripled to a record $18.1B as Data Center sales jumped 279% on AI demand — and it kept $9.2B as profit, about 51 cents of every dollar.
